name: API, DI & Middleware
description: API, DI & Middleware standard. Defines enforceable rules, implementation boundaries, failure handling and review evidence expected when STD-DOTNET-API applies.

rules.title: Use the ASP.NET Core middleware pipeline for cross-cutting concerns
rules.detail: Authentication, authorization, exception mapping, correlation, request logging and rate limiting belong in ordered middleware/filters rather than duplicated controller code.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Use the ASP.NET Core middleware pipeline for cross-cutting concerns.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Use the ASP.NET Core middleware pipeline for cross-cutting concerns.

rules.title: Keep controllers/endpoints thin
rules.detail: Bind/validate transport input, call application use cases and map results; business rules and EF queries do not belong directly in controllers.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Keep controllers/endpoints thin.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Keep controllers/endpoints thin.

rules.title: Use dependency injection with explicit lifetimes
rules.detail: Register stateless services appropriately, keep DbContext scoped, and avoid resolving scoped dependencies from singletons.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Use dependency injection with explicit lifetimes.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Use dependency injection with explicit lifetimes.

rules.title: Return consistent Problem Details or project error contracts
rules.detail: Map validation, not-found, conflict, forbidden and unexpected failures centrally with stable codes and correlation identifiers.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Return consistent Problem Details or project error contracts.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Return consistent Problem Details or project error contracts.

rules.title: Use CancellationToken through I/O boundaries
rules.detail: Propagate request cancellation to database/HTTP/stream operations where safe.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Use CancellationToken through I/O boundaries.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Use CancellationToken through I/O boundaries.

rules.title: Document endpoints through OpenAPI
rules.detail: Authentication, schemas, status responses and examples remain aligned with implementation.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Document endpoints through OpenAPI.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Document endpoints through OpenAPI.

integration_guide.title: Resolve applicability and dependencies
integration_guide.description: Confirm where STD-DOTNET-API applies and resolve its extends/implements/uses/aligns_with dependencies in the project standard profile.

integration_guide.title: Record project decisions
integration_guide.description: Apply the rules of API, DI & Middleware to requirements/design/ADRs and record any project-specific thresholds, providers or justified exceptions.

integration_guide.title: Implement with evidence
integration_guide.description: Implement the applicable MUST/SHOULD rules and link code, configuration, tests or review evidence to the change.

integration_guide.title: Verify before completion
integration_guide.description: Run automated checks where possible and manual review for judgement-based rules; close or approve documented deviations.

common_issues.issue: API, DI & Middleware is applied inconsistently across features
common_issues.cause: The project references the standard but does not resolve concrete ownership, thresholds or verification evidence.
common_issues.solution: Resolve dependencies, record project-specific decisions and include applicable rules in implementation/review checks.

common_issues.issue: Implementation satisfies the happy path but misses API, DI & Middleware failure cases
common_issues.cause: Boundary, retry, security or recovery scenarios were not included in acceptance/test planning.
common_issues.solution: Use the standard rules to add explicit failure/recovery scenarios and verify them before release.
